# Quench

> Local usage and spending diagnostics for Claude Code and Codex, with a Claude Code plugin.

## Documentation

- [Setup and reports](https://github.com/forgesworn/quench/blob/main/README.md): Install from source and inspect the local usage reports.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/quench): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
